metadata.dataset_title: Sahoo et al. (2016) 12-Litholog Working Dataset (Revised Digitization)
metadata.provenance_policy: Working dataset consists of mixed provenance: 3 existing/source-derived outcrop logs (including 1 benchmarked), 8 AI-assisted outcrop reconstructions, and 1 manually digitized subsurface core log (L12). In Sprint E, all 12 logs were manually digitized and revised by the user from source images. Downstream models and statistics reflect these updated digitized interval boundaries.

litholog1.notes: Original existing dataset log. Outcrop log 1. Manually digitized and revised from source image. Missing physical coordinates; strictly excluded from spatial modeling.

litholog12.source: Sahoo et al. (2016) / EM-137C Core Log
litholog12.reconstruction_method: manually digitized by the user from the supplied core-log image
litholog12.digitization_revision: manually digitized by the user from supplied core-log image
litholog12.scope_limitation: Digitized coverage strictly limited to 0-111m; core depths >111m not digitized; no extrapolation or invention of undigitized intervals.
litholog12.notes: Subsurface core log EM-137C. Manually digitized by the user from core-log image. Coverage strictly 0-111m (original core length 242m). Not AI-generated; independent validation undocumented/unvalidated. Coordinates available in Location_coordinates_lithologs.xlsx (Row 11: X=-1119.91, Y=14407.30).
